verdict.rationale: Supermemory automatically extracts facts, builds a living knowledge graph, and maintains auto-updating user profiles from ingested data — a form of AI-generated insight derived from raw content (supermemory-docs-14, supermemory-docs-15, supermemory-docs-33, supermemory-docs-40). However, there's no evidence of proactive 'suggestions' (e.g., recommended actions, next-step prompts) surfaced to the user — the product is positioned as memory infrastructure/API for retrieval rather than an insights/suggestions dashboard. Missing for 10: evidence of proactive suggestion generation, a user-facing insights UI, or explicit 'recommendation' features beyond fact/profile extraction.
